_meta.definition: The process of managing and maintaining information related to geographical features such as cities, countries, continents, deserts, islands, lakes, rivers, seas, and mountains.

geo_desert._description: Records geographical locations of deserts within their respective countries and provinces.

columns.name: Desert
columns.description: Stores names of Kalahari Deserts in multiple locations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores two-letter country codes for countries associated with deserts in Angola, Namibia, and Zaire (Z).

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical provinces associated with deserts.

geo_estuary._description: Captures geographical information about estuaries where rivers flow into specific countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for major rivers in various geographical locations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for estuaries.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores the names of provinces or counties for estuaries located in Iceland and Scandinavian countries.

geo_island._description: Captures geographical data of islands, including their names, associated countries, and provinces.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of various islands, such as Svalbard, Greenland, Iceland, Aust-Vagoey, Streymoy.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores abbreviated names of countries associated with geographical islands.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical names of provinces or regions associated with islands.

geo_lake._description: Tracks geographical distribution of lakes across countries and provinces.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for freshwater lakes in Finland.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country where the lake is located.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores Finnish provincial names for geographical lakes.

geo_river._description: Tracks geographical distribution of rivers across countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for various rivers.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for rivers.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores names of provinces or counties along rivers in Iceland and Norway.

geo_sea._description: Records geographical data of seas within specific provinces of various countries.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas bordering multiple countries in the Mondial database.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries bordering the sea.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical entities within Denmark or possibly Norwegian provinces.

geo_source._description: Tracks geographical sources of rivers across countries and provinces.

columns.name: River
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for various rivers worldwide.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for geographical data sources.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions (e.g., Iceland, Soer Trondelag, Oppland) within countries for geo_source table.

located._description: Records geographical locations of cities, provinces, countries, rivers, lakes, and seas in the Mondial database.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores names of cities in Albania and Greece.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions for locations, with examples including Albania, Attiki, Anatoliki Makedhonia kai Thraki.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for countries where vehicles are located.

columns.name: River
columns.description: The River column stores names of major European rivers.

columns.name: Lake
columns.description: Stores names of lakes from various countries.

columns.name: Sea
columns.description: Stores names of seas within the Mediterranean region.

locatedOn._description: Captures geographical locations of entities within Mondial database, including city, province/state, country, and island.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names of locations where Mondial companies are based.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions where Mondial companies are located, such as islands or provinces.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the location of a company.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of islands where Mondial companies are located.

mountainOnIsland._description: Records islands worldwide and their associated mountain peaks.

columns.name: Mountain
columns.description: Stores names of up to 50 characters for mountains located on islands.

columns.name: Island
columns.description: Stores names of islands where mountains are located.

organization._description: Captures details of various organizations, including their abbreviations, names, locations (city, country, province), and establishment dates.

columns.name: Abbreviation
columns.description: Stores up to 50 characters of abbreviated names for international organizations such as ACP, AfDB, ACCT, OPANAL, AG.

columns.name: Name
columns.description: Stores names of international organizations, such as regional groups and development banks.
samples: Agency for Cultural and Technical Cooperation
Agency for the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons in Latin America and the Caribbean

columns.name: City
columns.description: Stores city names for various global organizations.

columns.name: Country
columns.description: Stores ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes for organizations.

columns.name: Province
columns.description: Stores geographical regions for organizations, represented by provinces, districts, or states.

columns.name: Established
columns.description: Stores organization establishment dates as formatted strings (YYYY-MM-DD).
